infoPlist.NSCameraUsageDescription: Preppa uses the camera to scan the QR code at cash-on-delivery handoff, to add photos of your dishes, and to record video posts.
infoPlist.NSMicrophoneUsageDescription: Preppa uses the microphone to record audio for your video posts.
infoPlist.NSLocationWhenInUseUsageDescription: Preppa uses your location to show cooks and meals near you and to set your delivery address.
infoPlist.NSPhotoLibraryUsageDescription: Preppa uses your photo library to set your profile photo and let cooks attach photos of their dishes.

plugins.photosPermission: Preppa uses your photo library to set your profile photo and let cooks attach photos of their dishes.

plugins.cameraPermission: Preppa uses the camera to record video posts and to scan QR codes at handoff.
